# PCA Watch: account sample and search guide

About 120 public X accounts, built Oct 2026, in three groups. Lean labels are rough, from bios and posts, not verified affiliation; blank means not evident. Owners can add or remove accounts by editing this list.

## Group 1: Official, publications, institutions (31)
@timkellernyc (Broader/network); @CTmagazine (Broader); @TGC (Broader/network); @Ligonier; @ReformTheoSem; @reformedforum (Confessional); @AmReformer (Confessional/right); @wscal (Confessional); @mereorthodoxy (Broader/network); @RedeemerCTC (Broader/network); @prpbooks; @gospelinlife (Broader/network); @_Theopolis; @PCAByFaith (official PCA magazine); @DavenantInst; @GPTSeminary (Confessional); @Heidelblog01 (Confessional); @CovSeminary; @AquilaReport (Confessional); @heidelcast (Confessional); @RTSCharlotte; @gospelrefnet (Confessional/GRN); @RTSJackson; @rtsorlando; @coralridgepc; @pcamna; @PCACDM; @Fowl_Words (religion reporter); @DrThomasGibbs; @TheWSpod (Confessional); @presbycast (Confessional)

## Group 2: PCA pastors and elders (42)
@RevKevDeYoung (Confessional); @LigonDuncan (Confessional); @scottsauls (Broader); @ZacharyGarris (Confessional/right); @matt_everhard (Confessional); @TexasPreacher (Confessional); @CAHutch1990; @elimcgowan (Anti-Christian-nationalism conservative); @ZGroff; @irishpresby (Confessional); @fredgreco (Confessional; PCA Stated Clerk); @JoshuaTorrey; @SGMorris7 (Confessional); @MeltonDuncan (53rd GA Moderator); @GeorgeSayour; @caesar_beaver (Right); @RobPacienza; @RFBWCF (Confessional); @RDP4Christ (Confessional/GRN); @jeretics; @michaelkellers (Broader/network); @ScottC1517 (Confessional); @KromerHarry (Confessional/right); @nsxanders; @CWadeBaker; @AmericanPresby; @RevBCD (Confessional); @revpmr; @KepWhite (Broader/moderate); @BaldlyObserving; @CSWCF1646 (Confessional); @LordTemplar1 (Confessional/right); @JohnStSomething (Confessional); @ajaugenstein; @bustarymez96; @BroPresby (Confessional); @PastrBlastr1; @xzaksis; @w_dodd23 (Confessional); @jmensley; @DJCimino; @JohnRCainesJr (Confessional)

## Group 3: High-attention commentators (47)
@DavidAFrench (Broader); @megbasham (Right); @drmoore (Broader); @JoelWebbon (Hard right); @MattSmethurst (Broader); @Protestia (Confessional/right); @douglaswils (CREC); @thisisfoster (Hard right); @kkdumez (Progressive critic); @reachjulieroys (Accountability); @BonifaceOption (Hard right); @redeemed_zoomer (Mainline PCUSA); @aaron_renn (Right); @PerfInjust (Christian nationalist); @MikeCosper (Broader); @NateAFischer (Right); @joe_rigney (CREC); @jonharris1989 (Right); @not_our_guy; @collinhansen (Broader/network); @IVMiles; @RScottClark (Confessional URC); @BozT (Accountability); @PresbyInn; @wademullen (Accountability); @PresbySauce (Confessional); @jake_meador (Broader); @Joseph_Spurgeon (Right); @liamsadams (religion reporter); @PsalmWarfare (Paleo/right); @ShawnMathis1972 (Confessional); @AnglicanonMDiv; @kinisman (Kinist-adjacent); @tim_bertolet; @ptomer (Confessional/right); @whpub; @John_Barach (FV-adjacent); @ReformedSaxon (Christian nationalist); @danborvan (Confessional); @ehenes (OPC); @BringePeter (OPC); @dokimazete (Right); @RandyRunions; @the_silent_bell (Accountability); @Puritan1646 (Confessional); @2DLARBN (Anti-kinist); @bluegrasspresby (Mainline)

Caveat: the broader/network/progressive wing of the PCA is thin on X, so the sample leans confessional and right, as the X conversation itself does. Official and Keller-world accounts and journalists stand in for that side.

## 2027 General Assembly (54th GA)
- June 14-18, 2027, Baird Center, Milwaukee, WI (Central time). Committees of commissioners meet June 14-15.
- Run an extra midday report June 11-20, 2027 to cover pre-GA chatter and the wrap-up.
- Sources: https://pcaga.org/ and https://www.pcaga2027.org/. Overtures are posted at https://pcaga.org/resources/; presbytery votes on BCO amendments at https://www.pcaac.org/dashboard/
- Overture deadlines: Apr 16, 2027 for BCO/RAO amendments; May 15, 2027 for all others.
- Future GAs: Dallas, June 26-30, 2028; Orlando, June 25-29, 2029.

## Recurring topics (fall 2026)
Women's roles (FFO, deaconesses, women deacons, new overtures on titles and diaconal authority); Christian nationalism and kinism study reports; Keller/TGC/Redeemer legacy, Side B/Revoice, Covenant Seminary's direction; study committees (AI), Danvers Statement; SJC and discipline cases, BCO 8-7, abuse-accountability coverage; masculinity debates, the Vanguard Presbytery split.

## Hashtags and terms
- `#pcaga` is the main hashtag, used year-round and heavily in June. Watch `#PCAGA54` and `#pcaga2027`.
- Never use plain `#PCA`: it is swamped by baseball, the Permanent Court of Arbitration, and others.
- Terms: "PCA GA", "PCA General Assembly", overture, "Overtures Committee", SJC, "Standing Judicial Commission", BCO, RAO, presbytery, "Stated Clerk", Moderator, commissioner, teaching/ruling elder, FFO, deaconess, "study committee", "ad interim", GRN, byFaith, "Aquila Report", "Covenant Seminary", RTS, MNA, MTW, RUF, Vanguard, kinism, "Christian nationalism", "Side B", Revoice.

## Suggested queries (about six per report)
Search with the start time set to the previous report.
1. `(#pcaga OR "PCA GA" OR "PCA General Assembly" OR "54th GA") -is:retweet`
2. `PCA (overture OR "Overtures Committee" OR BCO OR RAO OR SJC OR "Standing Judicial" OR presbytery OR "Stated Clerk") -is:retweet lang:en`
3. `PCA (deaconess OR FFO OR "women deacons" OR kinism OR "Christian nationalism" OR Keller OR Redeemer OR "Side B" OR "study committee") -is:retweet lang:en`
4-6. Account sweeps: `from:a OR from:b ...` over the handles above, kept under 1,024 characters per query (about 25-30 handles). To stay at about six searches, prioritize the most active and highest-reach handles across the three groups, and rotate the rest between reports.
Rank by likes, reposts, quotes, and replies.

skills.name: pca-watch-getting-started
skills.description: Use for a new PCA Watch bot's first conversation with its owner: confirm report times and accounts, then create the report routines.
skills.content:
---
name: pca-watch-getting-started
description: >-
  Use for a new PCA Watch bot's first conversation with its owner: confirm
  report times and accounts, then create the report routines.
---
You report on the PCA (Presbyterian Church in America) conversation on X: which overtures, judicial cases, conferences, and debates drew the most attention since the last report, who is driving them, and how the different wings are reacting. You report fairly, give no verdicts, and use only public X reads.

Open with a short hello, then ask one at a time:
1. Report times. Defaults are 6 AM and 4:30 PM ET every day, plus 1 PM ET June 11-20, 2027 for the 54th General Assembly (June 14-18, Milwaukee). Ask whether those work or what times and time zone they want. Mention engagement tends to peak 6-9 PM ET.
2. Accounts. The starting sample is about 120 accounts in the pca-accounts skill. Ask whether they want to add or remove any, and update that skill if so.
3. Length. Short, scannable reports by default; ask whether weekend reports can be shorter.
4. Usage. Keep each run lean (about six searches) unless they want fuller coverage.

Then save their preferences to memory and create or adjust the routines: one for the daily reports at their chosen times, and one for the GA-week midday report that deletes itself after June 20, 2027. Keep the last-report time and a short running log of top topics in your own store so each report can mark topics as new or continuing. Tell them when the first report will arrive.

routines.name: PCA Watch morning and afternoon reports
routines.description: Fires twice a day (default 6 AM and 4:30 PM ET) to send a short report on the most-discussed {slack_channel_2} conversations on X since the last report.
routines.content:
Write the {slack_channel_2} Watch report: what the {slack_channel_2} (Presbyterian Church in America) conversation on X paid the most attention to since the last report.

Window: read the last report time from a last-report file in your own store (if missing, use the last 12 hours). Cover from then until now, and write the new time back when done.

Sources (public X reads only; look up the X tools' current schemas each run): use the pca-accounts skill for the account sample, hashtags, and suggested queries. Run about six searches total: account sweeps plus term searches covering {slack_channel} and {slack_channel_2} terms (overture, SJC, BCO, presbytery, GA, byFaith, Aquila). Ignore plain {slack_channel_2}. Never post, follow, like, create lists, sign into x.com, or message anyone on X.

Rank the 3-6 conversations that drew the most attention (likes + replies + reposts, and how many accounts joined in): overtures, judicial or discipline cases, conferences, trending debates and memes, GA business. For each, give a one-line summary, who is driving it, how the different wings are reacting (using the lean labels in pca-accounts), and links to the key posts (https://x.com/<handle>/status/<id>). Mark each topic as new or continuing using a running topic log in your own store, then append a short dated line of this run's top topics (keep about two weeks). Skip general culture-war posts not about the {slack_channel_2}. Report fairly with no verdicts. Keep it short and scannable; Saturday reports can be shorter. If almost nothing happened, send a one- or two-line note saying it was quiet.

Send the report to the owner in this Grok Bot chat, and to no one else.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 6 * * *`
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 30 16 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
- Slack channel

routines.name: PCA Watch GA midday report
routines.description: Fires at 1 PM ET June 11-20 to add a midday report during the 2027 {slack_channel_2} General Assembly week, then deletes itself.
routines.content:
Write the midday {slack_channel_2} Watch report for General Assembly week. This routine is only for June 11-20, 2027 (54th General Assembly, June 14-18, 2027, Milwaukee). If today is after June 20, 2027, delete this routine and stop with no message. If it is June 11-20 of an earlier year, stop quietly.

Window: read the last report time from the last-report file in your own store (if missing, use the last 7 hours), cover until now, and write the new time back.

Sources (public X reads only): use the pca-accounts skill. About six searches: account sweeps plus {slack_channel} and {slack_channel_2} terms (overture, SJC, BCO, presbytery, GA, byFaith, Aquila). Ignore plain {slack_channel_2}. Never post, follow, like, create lists, sign into x.com, or message anyone.

Rank the 3-6 conversations with the most attention, with GA floor business, overtures, votes, judicial cases, and trending debates front and center. For each: a one-line summary, who is driving it, how the wings are reacting, and links to key posts. Mark topics new or continuing from the running topic log in your own store and append this run's top topics. Fair, no verdicts, short and scannable.

Send the report to the owner in this Grok Bot chat, and to no one else.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 13 11-20 6 *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
- Slack channel
